title: AgriMind-AI-Agents (Ongoing)
description: Developing an AI system to understand Sinhala-language farmer queries, identify agricultural problems, and provide relevant guidance and recommendations using the Gemini API and AI agents.

title: Mobile Review Sentiment Analysis
description: Developed an NLP application to classify mobile reviews as positive, neutral, or negative. An integrated FastAPI backend, Streamlit dashboard, and Chrome extension provide sentiment predictions for customer feedback analysis.

title: AI-Powered Loan Default Prediction
description: Developed an end-to-end XGBoost system to predict loan default risk and explain predictions with SHAP. FastAPI and Streamlit deliver interactive risk assessments with database integration, data encryption, and fairness checks.

title: Sri Lanka Cost of Living & Inflation Analysis Dashboard
description: Analyzed 50,000+ retail-price observations across Sri Lanka to compare product prices and cost-of-living patterns by category and location. Created visualizations and DAX measures to identify price patterns and communicate insights.

title: Sri Lanka Tourism Intelligence
description: Analyzed Sri Lanka tourism data from 2018–2025 to identify trends, seasonal patterns, crisis impacts, and tourist arrival recovery. Developed an interactive dashboard, forecasting models, and automated data updates with GitHub Actions.

title: Lab Booking System
description: A PHP and MySQL web application for lab reservations, booking history, and administrator management of lab resources and reports.

title: AI-Based Business Analyzer
description: An AI-based business analysis project designed to help examine business information and surface useful insights for decision-making.

title: Supply Chain Performance Analytics Dashboard
description: An interactive Power BI dashboard analyzing over 180,000 orders across 164 countries, with sales, profitability, regional, shipping, and delivery performance insights.

title: ShopEasy
description: An e-commerce project focused on the online shopping experience, bringing product discovery and purchasing into one application.

title: Sales Data Analytics
description: A sales data analysis project focused on exploring transaction data, identifying performance patterns, and presenting findings that support business decisions.

title: HealthTrack
description: A health tracking project for organizing personal health information and making it easier to review health records over time.

title: ScrapeX
description: A web scraping project for collecting information from websites and preparing it for further use or analysis.
